news.body_zh: 本赛季的第一次国际比赛日为科巴姆下一代主教练哈里·哈德森提供了回顾迄今为止的赛季并展望即将到来的各种比赛挑战的机会。科巴姆下一代队在 2026/27 赛季取得了良好的开局，赢得了过去三场联赛，并且仍有望晋级 EFL 奖杯。球队表现出色，已有六名球员进球。由于切尔西队的出色表现，三名球员被提名为 9 月份英超联赛 2 月最佳球员奖。雷吉·沃森、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔和新加盟的利奥·布莱克都在八名提名者之列。在国际比赛暂停前，CNG 3-1 战胜同城死敌富勒姆，将连胜纪录扩大到三场，蓝军积 9 分排名第四。哈德森在回顾竞选的开始阶段时说：“这对孩子们来说是一个非常积极的开始。 CNG 团队在一起的时间越长，表演就越有凝聚力。 “我们对阵富勒姆的比赛表现非常出色。孩子们保持坚强、忠诚并专注于比赛计划。有几个进球是出色的团队进球，这对我们来说非常令人高兴。 CNG 队中有几位从 18 岁以下青年队中脱颖而出的年轻球员。哈德森透露，这背后的原因是我们“拥有出色的天赋，我们希望被推动，也值得被推动”。主教练补充道：“他们学习得非常快，在这个级别上踢的时间越长，他们就会变得越好，学得也越快。”我们对这座大楼拥有如此多的人才感到非常自豪。他们在天赋和努力之间取得了很好的平衡。”本赛季，9 月和 10 月的国际比赛日被合并为一个为期 16 天的时期，从 9 月 21 日到 10 月 6 日。我们的 7 名 CNG 球员目前正在离开自己的国家，除了代表苏格兰 U-19 队之外，还代表英格兰 U-17、U-18 和 U-19 年龄组。哈德森将延长休息时间描述为专注于每个球员个人发展的绝佳机会。哈德森说，我们的一些球员已经履行了国际义务，我们为此感到自豪，我们希望尽可能地支持这一点。 “对于那些没有参加过训练的球员来说，这也给了他们和一线队一起训练的机会，所以有很多机会。”国际比赛日结束后，CNG 在三项不同的比赛中还有四场比赛。首先是我们对阵雷丁的最后一场 EFL Trophy 小组赛。切尔西目前在南部 C 组排名第三，在点球大战中战胜了布里斯托尔流浪者队，并以 2-1 险胜威科姆流浪者队。在展望与皇家队的这场至关重要的杯赛比赛时，哈德森说道：“那场比赛的前两场表现都很强劲。如果我们能够从前两场比赛中吸取教训并将其结合起来，那么我们希望能够在对阵雷丁的比赛中取得积极的结果。我们需要赢球才能小组出线。 “这非常令人兴奋，因为这个月我们面临着如此多不同的挑战，而各种各样的比赛计划以不同的方式推动着年轻球员。”除了与雷丁的会面之外，年轻的蓝军还将在 PL2 中面对斯托克城和利物浦，然后于 10 月底在爱沙尼亚或法罗群岛进行第一场欧洲青年联赛，具体地点取决于弗洛拉·塔林和哈夫纳尔·博尔特费拉格之间的比赛。我们的主教练透露，球员们很享受出国踢球的机会，并将其称为“非凡的经历”。 “孩子们喜欢欧洲青年联赛。这是一种非常不同的体验，我们可以与来自世界各地的团队一起挑战自己。我们的目标是通过预选赛并进入 32 强。” 虽然 2026/27 赛季还处于初期阶段，但蓝军已经取得了令人鼓舞的开局。在所有比赛中，我们在六场比赛中打进了 16 个进球。随着国际比赛日即将结束，焦点转向即将到来的比赛。切尔西希望在 PL2 中攀得更高，并在 EFL 奖杯和 UEFA 青年联赛中取得进步。哈德森说：“会有一些高峰，也会有一些低谷。最近的一些日子里，事情开始走到一起。 “我向他们传达的最重要的信息是，他们都有自己想要实现的目标，这太棒了。他们实现这些个人目标的方法就是让我们成为最好的球队。” 现在还有时间购买在 Select 汽车租赁体育场对阵雷丁的 EFL 杯小组赛门票。比赛于 10 月 13 日星期二晚上 7 点开始。希望观看比赛的切尔西球迷需要注册一个帐户，然后在南看台的 R31-R32 街区购买门票。雷丁对阵科巴姆下一代的门票可通过此链接购买。支持者还可以通过天空体育观看比赛。

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: Essien or Hazard? Vote now
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极进球：埃辛还是阿扎尔？立即投票
news.body_en: And then there were two! We have narrowed down 20 strikes in our Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season competition to the final pairing, and now you need to choose which is the very best. Earlier in this international break, we split the winners of the Chelsea Goal of the Season award into four different groups. From there, eight goals advanced to the quarter-finals, four to the semis, and now the knockout stage has reached its finale. Our two finalists both had multiple entries in the competition, and it is their goals against Arsenal that have made it to the end. Michael Essien's thunderous strike that won the 2007 Goal of the Season award meets Eden Hazard's solo effort from a decade later. They are both legendary Chelsea goals, but which is your favourite? Watch them back in the video below and then have your say by voting in our poll! Vote for your Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season winner! Essien’s strike against Arsenal beat Ramires' chip in Barcelona in the semis. With the Blues behind to The Gunners at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball off to the Ghanaian around 30 yards out and the midfielder let rip with a glorious swerving strike that flew into the top corner. Hazard's strike against Arsenal showcased everything Eden had to offer the Blues. Picking up possession inside his own half, the Belgian displayed strength to shrug off Francis Coquelin while retaining his balance to take on the Arsenal backline before calmly beating Petr Cech to register a sensational solo goal. Vote for your Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season winner! Return tomorrow (Tuesday) to find out which effort has won the Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season competition!
news.body_zh: 然后就有两个了！我们已经将切尔西赛季终极进球比赛中的 20 个进球缩小到了最后一对，现在您需要选择最好的一对。在国际比赛日早些时候，我们将切尔西赛季最佳进球奖的获得者分为四个不同的组。此后，8个进球晋级四分之一决赛，4个进球晋级半决赛，现在淘汰赛阶段已进入收官阶段。我们的两位决赛入围者都曾多次参加比赛，正是他们对阵阿森纳的进球才让他们走到了最后。迈克尔·埃辛 (Michael Essien) 的雷霆万钧的进球赢得了 2007 年赛季最佳进球奖，与十年后伊登·阿扎尔 (Eden Hazard) 的个人射门相得益彰。他们都是切尔西的传奇进球，但你最喜欢哪一个？在下面的视频中观看他们的表演，然后在我们的投票中投票发表您的意见！投票选出您心目中的切尔西赛季终极进球得主！半决赛中埃辛对阵阿森纳的进球击败了拉米雷斯在巴塞罗那的比赛中的进球。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后枪手时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球传给了 30 码外的加纳人，这位中场球员一脚漂亮的转身射门，飞入球门上角。阿扎尔对阵阿森纳的进球展示了伊甸园为蓝军提供的一切。比利时人在本方半场拿到控球权后，展现出了力量，摆脱了弗朗西斯·科奎林的防守，同时保持平衡，挑战了阿森纳的后防线，然后冷静地击败了切赫，打进了一粒轰动一时的个人进球。投票选出您心目中的切尔西赛季终极进球得主！明天（周二）回来看看哪项努力赢得了切尔西赛季终极进球比赛！

John Terry, who skippered the side to 15 major trophies in a momentous Blues career, will be turning back the clock to take on Tottenham once again, stirring memories of some of the club’s most historic battles against our London rivals. Indeed, JT scored against Spurs in the final of the 2015 League Cup, just one of the 717 matches he played, placing him third in the Chelsea all-time appearance tables. news.title: Keira Walsh on Chelsea's momentum and desire for more goals
news.title_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什谈切尔西的势头和对更多进球的渴望
news.body_en: After just nine matches, Keira Walsh has already equalled her tally of three goals last season, and now she’s hungry for even more. When the midfielder receives the ball on the edge of the penalty area, almost everyone inside the stadium now knows that she is going to shoot, but as head coach Sonia Bompastor remarked after our 3-0 win over West Ham on Sunday, there’s very little defenders can do about it. The emergence of Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter has allowed Walsh to move out of her usual role as a deep-lying playmaker and advance, safe in the knowledge that her young team-mate can always be relied upon to sweep up any loose balls. Our previous performances had been so impressive that West Ham believed they must put every player behind the ball to stand any chance of taking anything from the game, and Walsh explained how we remained calm until Melvine Malard broke the deadlock after 38 minutes of perseverance. ‘It was important to finish the block with a win, and I thought it was a good team performance,’ she said. ‘We have played a lot of tough games, so we're really happy with that. ‘It's about staying disciplined and just trusting it's going to come. They’re a good team. They're hard to break down, and it was about waiting for our chances to come. In the second half, we played a little bit quicker with more intensity. ‘We were pressing more, trying to go forward when we won it back, and that was the difference.’ Walsh doubled our advantage in the final stages with a superb long-range effort. But rather than bask in the glory, the ever-professional midfielder rued a missed opportunity when she hit the post after 67 minutes. Such discontent explains everything about the standards she sets for herself. ‘I was a bit disappointed with the one that hit the post and didn't go in,’ she reflected. ‘I probably should have scored it. I'm enjoying my football, and I think we're playing really well as a team. ‘We've got each other's backs, and if it's not me scoring, it's someone else. I’m really happy to be in this team. We have good momentum; we’re in good form, and we probably don't want the break to come. I'm enjoying the games, and the more games I play, the happier I am.’ Sunday's win marked our sixth consecutive clean sheet in all competitions. Our success in attack has been built on those rock-solid foundations at the back. It’s been nine hours since the Blues last conceded a goal, something that Bompastor puts down to an increased focus on physical tenacity and a strong group mindset. Walsh explained more about this season’s focus. ‘I didn't know it was nine hours!’ she gasped. ‘It seems like a long time! It’s the way they're all playing at the back, to be honest. There’s a massive focus on first and second balls as well, and we're definitely doing better at that this year. ‘Whoever has played in our back three has been incredible, and Hannah (Hampton) too: the save she made in the Champions League shows the quality she brings. It’s a case of trusting each other's abilities and staying really compact as a team and fighting for each other. That sort of record is a team effort; it's not just the back four or five. ‘In the first half we were making a lot of balls to the front of the press from centre-back. A lot of opportunities come when you pick the second balls up, and that's always something that we really try and focus on, and I think we've done that really well. Hopefully that continues, and we keep building the momentum on this good run that we've just had.’
news.body_zh: 仅仅九场比赛之后，凯拉·沃尔什就已经追平了她上赛季的三粒进球，现在她渴望更多。当中场球员在禁区边缘接球时，几乎球场内的每个人都知道她要射门，但正如主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在周日我们 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队后所说，防守队员几乎无能为力。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特的出现，让沃尔什摆脱了她通常作为一名后撤组织核心的角色，并安全地前进，因为她知道她的年轻队友总是可以依靠来扫除任何松散的球。我们之前的表现令人印象深刻，西汉姆联相信他们必须让每个球员都在球后，才有机会从比赛中获得任何东西，沃尔什解释了我们如何保持冷静，直到梅尔文·马拉德在坚持了 38 分钟后打破了僵局。 “以一场胜利结束本次比赛很重要，我认为这是一场很好的团队表现，”她说。 “我们踢了很多艰难的比赛，所以我们对此感到非常高兴。 ‘这是关于保持纪律并相信它会到来。他们是一支优秀的团队。他们很难被击垮，我们需要等待机会的到来。下半场我们打得更快了一些，强度也更大了。 “当我们赢回球权时，我们施加了更多压力，试图继续前进，这就是不同之处。”沃尔什在最后阶段凭借出色的远射将我们的优势扩大了一倍。但这位曾经的职业中场球员并没有沉浸在荣耀之中，而是在第 67 分钟击中门柱时后悔了自己错失的良机。这种不满解释了她为自己设定的标准的一切。 “我对那个击中门柱但没有进的球感到有点失望，”她回忆道。 “我可能应该进球。我很享受我的足球，我认为我们作为一个团队踢得非常好。 “我们互相支持，如果不是我进球，那就是别人。我真的很高兴能加入这个团队。我们势头良好；我们的状态很好，我们可能不希望休息到来。我很享受比赛，我踢的比赛越多，我就越高兴。周日的胜利标志着我们在所有比赛中连续第六次不失球。我们进攻的成功是建立在后防线坚如磐石的基础上的。距离蓝军上次失球已经过去九个小时了，邦帕斯特将这归因于对身体韧性和强大团队心态的更加关注。沃尔什详细解释了本赛季的重点。 “我不知道已经九个小时了！”她喘着气说。 ‘看来已经很久了啊！老实说，这就是他们在后场的比赛方式。第一球和第二球也受到了极大的关注，今年我们在这方面肯定做得更好。 “无论谁在我们的三后卫中踢球，都令人难以置信，汉娜（汉普顿）也是如此：她在冠军联赛中所做的扑救表明了她所带来的品质。这是一个信任彼此能力、保持团队紧密并为彼此而战的例子。这种记录是团队努力的成果；不仅仅是后四名或后五名。 “上半场我们从中后卫向逼抢前送出很多球。当你接住第二个球时，就会有很多机会，这始终是我们真正尝试和关注的事情，我认为我们做得非常好。希望这种情况能够继续下去，我们在刚刚取得的良好进展的基础上继续保持势头。”

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Premier League return takes centre stage
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：英超回归成为焦点
news.body_en: Premier League football returns to Stamford Bridge this week, while exclusive interviews, international action and Academy fixtures also feature across the official Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App. Here is what to look out for from Monday 5 October to Sunday 11 October, as Xabi Alonso’s side prepare to host Bournemouth and the final Chelsea players on international duty complete their schedules. The week begins with Keira Walsh reflecting on Chelsea Women’s 3-0 win at West Ham United. Our Ultimate Goal of the Season competition has reached its finale, while in the evening there is international action. Mike Penders and Romeo Lavia’s Belgium visit Maxence Lacroix's France in the UEFA Nations League. We will bring you updates on any Chelsea players who feature for their countries. The extended international break concludes when Emiliano Martinez and Valentin Barco’s Argentina host Benin in their final friendly, while England take on Czechia in the Nations League. There is also Under-21 international action, with Josh Acheampong's England side facing the Republic of Ireland in their UEFA European Championship qualifier, while Geovany Quenda and Portugal Under-21s meet Czechia. Look out for our final updates on the Blues involved and a round-up of the international window. With no senior or Academy fixture scheduled for the Blues, attention turns towards the weekend. We will continue to bring you the latest news from Cobham as the returning internationals link back up with their club team-mates. The Blues' last Premier League outing came at Brentford on 18 September, before the extended international break created a longer-than-usual pause in domestic action. Chelsea will now be looking to return to winning ways when Bournemouth visit Stamford Bridge. The build-up to Chelsea’s Premier League meeting with Bournemouth gathers pace. Our preview coverage will set the scene for the Blues’ first club fixture following the extended international break. We will also hear from summer signing Pep Chavarria in an exclusive interview, giving supporters the chance to get to know more about the defender and his experiences since joining the Blues. Alonso will face the media at Cobham ahead of Chelsea’s Premier League return. Supporters can follow the head coach’s press conference live on the official Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App, with all the key talking points and team news to follow. We will continue our build-up to Chelsea versus Bournemouth with the latest from both camps, key statistics and everything supporters need to know before the game. It is a double-header as the action returns. The Under-18s begin the day by hosting Manchester United at Cobham, with kick-off at 11am. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live on the official Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. Then the focus moves to Stamford Bridge, where Chelsea host Bournemouth in the Premier League at 3pm. As ever, supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live action in our Chelsea vs Bournemouth Match Centre on the official Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. We will have minute-by-minute updates, live commentary, the match report and reaction from Stamford Bridge, along with all the best post-match content. Alonso and his players will be looking to make a positive return after the extended international break, with the Cherries providing the opposition in SW6. We will continue to bring you reaction from Saturday’s Premier League fixture, including highlights, analysis and interviews from Stamford Bridge, as well as highlights of the Under-18s’ meeting with Manchester United.
news.body_zh: 英超联赛本周将重返斯坦福桥，而切尔西官方网站和切尔西官方应用程序上也会出现独家采访、国际赛事和青训营赛程。以下是从 10 月 5 日星期一到 10 月 11 日星期日期间值得关注的事情，哈维·阿隆索的球队准备主场迎战伯恩茅斯，而最后一批参加国际比赛的切尔西球员也将完成他们的日程安排。本周伊始，凯拉·沃尔什回顾了切尔西女足 3-0 战胜西汉姆联的比赛。我们的赛季终极目标比赛已经进入决赛，晚上还有国际比赛。迈克·潘德斯和罗密欧·拉维亚的比利时队在欧洲国家联赛中拜访了马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦队的法国队。我们将为您带来代表国家队出场的切尔西球员的最新动态。当埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯和瓦伦丁·巴尔科率领的阿根廷队在最后一场友谊赛中迎战贝宁队，而英格兰队则在国家联赛中迎战捷克队时，延长的国际比赛日就结束了。此外还有21岁以下国家队的国际比赛，乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong）的英格兰队将在欧洲杯预选赛中对阵爱尔兰共和国，而乔瓦尼·昆达（Geovany Quenda）和葡萄牙21岁以下队将迎战捷克队。请留意我们有关蓝军的最终更新以及国际比赛窗口的汇总。由于蓝军没有安排高级队或青训营的比赛，人们的注意力转向了周末。随着回归的国脚与他们的俱乐部队友恢复联系，我们将继续为您带来科巴姆的最新消息。蓝军的最后一场英超比赛是9月18日在布伦特福德举行的，随后国际比赛日的延长导致国内比赛的停顿时间比平时更长。切尔西现在希望在伯恩茅斯造访斯坦福桥时重回胜利之路。切尔西与伯恩茅斯的英超比赛的准备工作正在加快进行。我们的预览报道将为蓝军在国际比赛日延长后的首场俱乐部比赛做好准备。我们还将接受夏季签约球员佩普·查瓦里亚的独家采访，让球迷有机会更多地了解这位后卫以及他加盟蓝军以来的经历。在切尔西重返英超之前，阿隆索将在科巴姆面对媒体。支持者可以在切尔西官方网站和切尔西官方应用程序上实时关注主教练的新闻发布会，其中包括所有关键谈话要点和球队新闻。我们将继续为切尔西对阵伯恩茅斯做准备，提供双方阵营的最新信息、关键统计数据以及球迷在赛前需要了解的一切信息。当动作返回时，这是一个双标题。 18 岁以下青年队将在科巴姆主场迎战曼联，比赛将于上午 11 点开球。 CFC+订阅者可以在切尔西官方网站和切尔西官方应用程序上观看比赛直播。然后焦点转移到斯坦福桥，切尔西将于下午 3 点在英超联赛中主场迎战伯恩茅斯。一如既往，支持者可以在切尔西官方网站和切尔西官方应用程序上关注切尔西对阵伯恩茅斯比赛中心的所有赛前准备、球队新闻和现场直播。我们将提供每分钟的更新、现场评论、比赛报告和斯坦福桥的反应，以及所有最好的赛后内容。阿隆索和他的球员们将寻求在延长的国际比赛日结束后取得积极的回报，而樱桃队将在 SW6 中成为对手。我们将继续为您带来周六英超比赛的反应，包括来自斯坦福桥的精彩集锦、分析和采访，以及 18 岁以下青年队与曼联比赛的精彩集锦。

news.title: Midfielder voted as your Star of the Match against West Ham!
news.title_zh: 中场球员被评选为您对阵西汉姆联队的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea Women continued their excellent start to the new season with a 3-0 victory away at West Ham on Sunday, and Blues fans have voted for their standout performer. A first-half strike from Melvine Malard, plus goals from Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano, secured the three points in Dagenham on Sunday before our players left for international duty. This was our sixth consecutive clean sheet in all competitions, and the victory left us just two points shy of Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League table. Walsh has been voted as your Star of the Match, earning a 53 per cent share of the votes for another brilliant strike and her all-round performance in her slightly more attacking role. Coming in second place with 27 per cent of the votes was Lucy Bronze for another hard-working performance at the back, while Melvine Malard took third position with 14 per cent of the overall tally for her superb turn and finish to open the scoring after 38 minutes.
news.body_zh: 周日，切尔西女足客场 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队，延续了新赛季的出色开局，蓝军球迷投票选出了她们表现出色的球员。梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）上半场的进球，加上凯拉·沃尔什（Keira Walsh）和麦卡·滨野（Maika Hamano）的进球，周日在达根纳姆（Dagenham）确保了我们的球员前往国际比赛之前获得三分。这是我们在各项赛事中连续第六次不失球，这场胜利使我们仅落后女超积分榜榜首的曼城两分。沃尔什被选为本场比赛之星，她以 53% 的得票率凭借另一次精彩的进球以及在进攻性稍强的角色中的全面表现而被选为本场比赛之星。露西·布朗兹（Lucy Bronze）以 27% 的得票率位居第二，她在后场的表现也很努力，而梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）凭借出色的转身和 38 分钟后首开纪录，以 14% 的得票率位居第三。

news.title: Internationals: Hato gets minutes in Netherlands win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：哈托在荷兰队获胜中获得上场时间
news.body_en: Jorrel Hato played his first game of this international window as the Netherlands defeated Serbia 2-1 in the UEFA Nations League. Hato was introduced by Xavi on the hour, at which point the game in Eindhoven was locked at 1-1. Teun Koopmeiners' opener after 31 minutes was swiftly cancelled out by Mihajlo Cvetkovic. Not long after Hato entered the fray, Joshua Zirkzee scored the winning goal, with the Blues defender completing all 21 passes he attempted during his time on the pitch. The Dutch held on to move top of their Nations League group as they seek a spot in next year's knockout rounds. They play Greece and Germany in their final two fixtures in November. Elsewhere, Pedro Neto was an unused sub as Portugal defeated Norway 2-1 to make it four wins out of four in the Nations League in this window. They will guarantee a quarter-final berth if they avoid defeat against Denmark - who beat Wales tonight - in their next game. Earlier on Sunday, Reggie Watson scored a penalty for England Under-17s but they were beaten 3-2 by Germany in their final game of this window.
news.body_zh: 乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）在欧洲国家联赛中踢了他本次国际比赛的首场比赛，帮助荷兰队以 2-1 击败塞尔维亚队。哈托在比赛进行到一小时时由哈维换下，此时埃因霍温的比赛战成1-1。第 31 分钟后，Teun Koopmeiners 的首开纪录很快就被 Mihajlo Cvetkovic 取消。哈托加入战斗后不久，约书亚·齐尔克泽攻入致胜一球，这位蓝军后卫完成了他在场上尝试的全部 21 次传球。荷兰队在国联小组中保持领先地位，寻求明年淘汰赛的席位。他们将在 11 月的最后两场比赛中对阵希腊和德国。其他方面，佩德罗·内托作为替补未上场，带领葡萄牙2-1击败挪威，在本窗口期的欧国联四场比赛中取得四胜。如果他们能避免在下一场比赛中输给今晚击败威尔士的丹麦队，他们将确保进入四分之一决赛。周日早些时候，雷吉·沃森 (Reggie Watson) 为英格兰 U-17 队打入点球，但他们在本窗口最后一场比赛中以 3-2 被德国队击败。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on finding a way to win and praise for Potter
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 寻找获胜方法并对波特表示赞扬
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained how the Blues put together a 3-0 win over West Ham and described Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter as a 'starter' for the team. A clinical finish from Melvine Malard seven minutes from half-time saw us take the lead, while goals in the final ten minutes of the match from Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano completed a dominant display against the Hammers. This was our sixth consecutive clean sheet. Today's game was played at the end of a gruelling 11 days during which time we faced Austria Vienna and Arsenal at home before away matches against Lyon and West Ham. 'When you are Chelsea, you need to find different ways to win the games,' said Bompastor after the 3-0 victory. 'Today was about winning. We knew coming into this game that it was the last one in a really intense and condensed block: many fixtures, big games, and also a lot of travel. 'We weren’t as fresh as we would have liked to have been, but we found a way to win. We didn't concede much against this team, and we know they were probably looking to hurt us in transition. 'We knew coming into this game we had to be a little bit patient because we were going to face a team that would defend with a back five today, a low block, so the spaces were not always open. 'So we stayed strong; we scored a really important goal in the first half, we kept the clean sheet, and we were able to break them in the second half.' The Blues head coach introduced Lexi Potter at half-time in place of Sjoeke Nusken. The 20-year-old has impressed with some strong displays alongside Keira Walsh in midfield, so much so that Potter will now join up with the senior England side for the first time. Bompastor linked a more controlled second-half performance with Potter's introduction. She even went so far as to say that the Academy graduate had won a place among Chelsea's starters, before also praising Walsh's impact against West Ham. 'As you could see, when Lexi is playing for our team, she is really good right now,' she explained. 'She brings calmness; she brings quality on the ball. At the level she's performing right now, she's a starter for us. There is no doubt about that. 'We controlled the ball more in the second half, and the quality we had on the ball was better as well. With Lexi being on the pitch, it helps a lot. 'Keira is playing a little bit higher than probably last season. It helps us a lot in terms of creating opportunities. We know how good she is when she is at the edge of the box; even if the opposition knows what she’s going to do, her shot is so great that she’s able to score. 'And right now it's good to have a player who is confident and brings us the solution to scoring goals. That's really important.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 解释了蓝军如何 3-0 战胜西汉姆联队，并将切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 描述为球队的“首发”。半场结束后 7 分钟，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 的冷静射门让我们取得了领先，而凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 和麦卡·滨野 (Maika Hamano) 在比赛最后 10 分钟的进球完成了对铁锤队的统治性表现。这是我们连续第六次零失球。今天的比赛是在艰苦的 11 天之后进行的，这期间我们主场对阵奥地利维也纳和阿森纳，然后客场对阵里昂和西汉姆联。 “当你是切尔西队的时候，你需要找到不同的方式来赢得比赛，”邦帕斯特在3-0获胜后说道。 “今天是关于胜利的。我们知道，进入这场比赛后，这是一场真正紧张而紧凑的比赛中的最后一场：许多赛程、大型比赛，还有大量的旅行。 “我们并没有像我们希望的那样充满活力，但我们找到了获胜的方法。我们在对阵这支球队时并没有丢太多球，而且我们知道他们可能想在攻防转换中伤害我们。 “我们知道进入这场比赛我们必须有点耐心，因为今天我们将面对一支用五后卫防守的球队，一个低位防守，所以空间并不总是开放的。 “所以我们保持坚强；我们在上半场打进了一个非常重要的进球，我们保持了不失球，并在下半场打破了对手。”蓝军主教练在半场休息时用莱克西·波特代替了肖克·努斯肯。这位20岁的球员在中场与凯拉·沃尔什并肩作战时的出色表现给人留下了深刻的印象，以至于波特现在将首次与英格兰成年队联手。邦帕斯特将下半场更加受控的表现与波特的上场联系起来。她甚至说这位青训毕业生已经在切尔西的首发中赢得了一席之地，然后还赞扬了沃尔什在对阵西汉姆联队的比赛中的表现。 “正如你所看到的，当莱克西为我们球队效力时，她现在真的很棒，”她解释道。 “她带来平静；她给球带来了质量。以她现在的表现来说，她是我们的先发球员。毫无疑问。 “下半场我们控球能力更强，控球质量也更好。有莱克西在场上，这很有帮助。 “凯拉的表现比上赛季可能要高一些。它在创造机会方面对我们有很大帮助。当她处于禁区边缘时，我们知道她有多出色。即使对手知道她要做什么，她的射门也非常出色，能够得分。 “现在拥有一名充满自信并为我们带来进球解决方案的球员是件好事。这真的很重要。

news.title: Match report: West Ham United 0-3 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 赛报：西汉姆联0-3切尔西女足
news.body_en: Goals from Melvine Malard, Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano sealed a valuable victory away to West Ham United on Sunday afternoon. Coming straight into today's clash with West Ham after Wednesday's tough battle against Lyon was always going to be a big ask for the Blues. It was therefore no surprise that it was tough to find a way through during the opening exchanges as we were unable to create any clear-cut chances. Our pressing paid off after 38 minutes, when Sjoeke Nusken pounced on some slack short passing from the Hammers in midfield, setting up Melvine Malard with her back to goal. The striker did not need to be asked twice to turn and finish, putting us ahead at the break with a fine strike. There was not much action at either end for long periods of the second half, but after some changes from Sonia Bompastor, we were able to extend our advantage. A trademark effort from Walsh from the edge of the penalty area was followed by a header from Maika Hamano, both goals created by Alyssa Thompson on the left. At the end of a gruelling period of fixtures, this was the best way to finish before the international break: a 3-0 victory and our sixth clean sheet in a row during a match where West Ham produced nothing in the final third of the pitch. Bompastor made just two alterations from our impressive 0-0 draw away at Lyon in midweek, switching Lexi Potter and Thompson for Sandy Baltimore and Hamano, the Japan international making her first start of the season. Erin Cuthbert made the matchday squad for the first time since being announced as Chelsea captain, having completed her recovery from an injury sustained whilst on international duty with Scotland during the summer. And the Blues started the game in Dagenham with typical intent. Ellie Carpenter stormed down the right wing and got her cross away, forcing the home side to clear their lines quickly. And when Walsh made a run down the channel and played a diagonal ball to Nusken in the box, the Chelsea number six couldn't quite keep her shot down as she slid in to meet the cross. Carpenter won a corner on the half-hour mark with a powerful half-volley, which ricocheted off a West Ham defender. But the Blues were struggling to make a real impact in the final third, with no shots on target to show for 64 per cent possession and 16 touches in the opposition box. Up until that point, striker Malard hadn't had much of a sniff on goal. Yet when she got a chance, she took it with a clinical finish to put us in front eight minutes before half-time. The opportunity came from a West Ham free-kick in the midfield area. Nusken, sensing a moment's hesitation, used the press to steal the ball from the opposition and strode forward, with the ball finding Malard. The number nine received it with her back to goal, but stood strong, turned and stroked her finish into the bottom corner. We headed in at the interval with the one-goal advantage, and the home side had failed to take a single shot on goal in the opening 45 minutes. Neither side was able to fashion a clear chance after the restart, but just after the hour mark the Blues came alive once more. Some neat interplay on the edge of the box between Wieke Kaptein, Malard and Walsh was only lacking the finish to make it 2-0. Bompastor then shuffled the pack in attack, bringing on Aggie Beever-Jones and Alyssa Thompson in place of Baltimore and goalscorer Malard. The fresh impetus saw us go close when Beever-Jones charged down the right flank, playing the ball square to Kaptein on the edge of the area. Walsh then took her trademark shot from range, crashing her attempt onto the right-hand post. A 1-0 victory wouldn't have done Chelsea's dominance justice, and after looking dangerous from the edge of the area all game, Walsh finally got her goal and added our second of the afternoon. Thompson jinked her way towards goal from the left-hand side before playing a short sideways pass for Kaptein. The Netherlands international quickly shifted the ball to Walsh, and the midfielder used her tried and tested technique to fire the ball into the bottom corner. The strike put the match beyond reasonable doubt against a side who had still not registered a single shot on goal. Our third of the afternoon came from another of Thompson's runs down the left. This time, the American took a shot, which was saved before Beever-Jones picked up the loose ball and steered it towards Hamano, who was able to head home at the far post. Substitute McCabe whipped in a corner right under the crossbar, with keeper Constance Picaud-Inconnu only just managing to tip it over. The final whistle blew with no shots and no touches in our box from the home side. A truly dominant performance to end this block of fixtures. The victory, along with Tottenham's defeat to London City Lionesses, means we move into top spot in the WSL, pending Manchester City's result with Arsenal later this afternoon. Our players will now head off to represent their respective national teams during the international break. We return to action with a home game against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October. Chelsea:  Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan (McCabe 77), Buurman (Bjorn 86), Kaptein, Walsh, Nusken (Potter h-t), Baltimore (Thompson 65), Hamano, Malard (Beever-Jones 65)Unused substitutes: Peng, Cuthbert, Dragoni, James Scorers: Malard 38, Walsh 80, Hamano 87Booked: Kaptein 32 West Ham: Picaud-Inconnu, Codina, Siren, Belloumou, Kumagai, Zelem (c), Gago (Wandeler 69), Asseyi, Riesen (Endo 88), Cascarino, Puibel (Tennebo 81)Unused substitutes: Walsh, Dowsett, Wareing, Morgan, PeacockReferee: Sophie Dennington
news.body_zh: 周日下午，梅尔文·马拉德、凯拉·沃尔什和滨野麦卡的进球锁定了客场对阵西汉姆联队的宝贵胜利。在周三对阵里昂的艰苦战斗之后，直接进入今天与西汉姆联的比赛对蓝军来说总是一个很大的要求。因此，在开局交锋中很难找到出路也就不足为奇了，因为我们无法创造任何明确的机会。第 38 分钟后，我们的逼抢得到了回报，Sjoeke Nusken 接住了铁锤帮中场的短传，为梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 背身球门助攻。这名前锋不需要两次转身就完成射门，凭借一脚漂亮的射门让我们在中场休息时取得领先。下半场的很长一段时间里，双方都没有太多动作，但在索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔做出一些改变后，我们能够扩大我们的优势。沃尔什在禁区边缘打出标志性射门，随后滨野麦卡头球破门，这两粒进球均由左侧的阿丽莎·汤普森攻入。在经历了一段艰苦的比赛之后，这是国际比赛日之前最好的结束方式：我们以 3-0 取得胜利，并在西汉姆联队在最后三分之一的比赛中连续第六次不失球。周中我们客场0-0战平里昂的比赛中，邦帕斯特只做出了两次调整，用莱克西·波特和汤普森换下了桑迪·巴尔的摩和日本国脚滨野，这是她本赛季的首次首发。艾琳·库斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert) 自被宣布担任切尔西队长以来首次入选比赛日阵容，她在夏季代表苏格兰国家队期间受伤，现已完全康复。蓝军在达格纳姆以典型的意图开始了比赛。埃莉·卡彭特从右翼猛冲过来，将她的传中球挡开，迫使主队迅速清理防线。当沃尔什沿着通道跑动并向禁区内的努斯肯打出斜线球时，这位切尔西六号球员在滑入接球时无法完全控制射门。卡彭特在半小时内凭借一记强力半凌空抽射赢得了角球，球被西汉姆联后卫击中。但蓝军在最后三分之一的比赛中难以发挥真正的作用，在对方禁区有 64% 的控球率和 16 次触球，没有射正。在那之前，前锋马拉德还没有对进球有太多的嗅觉。然而，当她有机会时，她以冷静的射门抓住了机会，在半场结束前八分钟让我们领先。机会来自西汉姆联中场的任意球。努斯肯察觉到了片刻的犹豫，利用压迫从对方手中抢断了球，大步向前，球传给了马拉德。九号球员背对球门接球，但她坚强地站了起来，转身将球射入球门底角。我们在中场休息时以一球优势头球破门，而主队在开场45分钟内一次都没能射正。比赛重新开始后，双方都未能创造出明显的机会，但就在一个小时之后，蓝军再次活跃起来。 Wieke Kaptein、Malard 和 Walsh 在禁区边缘巧妙的配合，只是缺少射门，将比分改写为 2-0。随后，邦帕斯特在进攻中重新调整了阵容，用阿吉·比弗-琼斯和阿丽莎·汤普森代替巴尔的摩和进球者马拉德。当比弗-琼斯从右翼冲锋，将球传给禁区边缘的卡普坦时，我们的新动力让我们逼近了比分。随后沃尔什进行了她标志性的远距离射门，击中了右侧门柱。 1-0 的胜利并不能体现切尔西的统治地位，整场比赛在禁区边缘看起来都很危险，沃尔什终于进球了，为我们打进了下午的第二粒进球。汤普森从左侧冲向球门，然后为卡普坦进行了一次短侧传球。荷兰国脚迅速将球传给沃尔什，沃尔什用她久经考验的技术将球射入底角。这一粒进球让这场比赛毫无疑问地战胜了一支还没有射门的球队。下午的第三个进球来自汤普森的另一次左路跑动。这一次，美国人射门，但在比弗-琼斯捡起球并将其引向滨野之前，射门被扑出，滨野在远门柱头球破门。 替补出场的麦凯布在横梁正下方开出角球，门将康斯坦斯·皮考德-因康努刚刚将球打翻。终场哨响了，主队没有射门，也没有触球。一场真正具有统治力的表现结束了这一系列的比赛。这场胜利，加上托特纳姆热刺队输给伦敦城狮队，意味着我们将跻身女超级联赛榜首，等待今天下午晚些时候曼城对阵阿森纳的结果。我们的球员现在将在国际比赛日期间代表各自的国家队出发。 10 月 18 日，我们将在斯坦福桥主场迎战托特纳姆热刺队。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（c）、布坎南（麦凯布 77）、布尔曼（比约恩 86）、卡普坦、沃尔什、努斯肯（波特 h-t）、巴尔的摩（汤普森 65）、滨野、马拉德（比弗-琼斯 65）未上场替补：彭、库斯伯特、德拉戈尼、詹姆斯 进球者：马拉德 38、沃尔什80、滨野 87 黄牌：卡普坦 32 西汉姆联：皮科-因康努、科迪纳、塞伦、贝卢穆、熊谷、泽勒姆（中）、加戈（万德勒 69）、阿塞伊、里森（远藤 88）、卡斯卡里诺、普伊贝尔（天内博 81）未上场替补：沃尔什、多塞特、韦林、摩根、孔雀裁判：索菲·丹宁顿
